messages:
jordan: hi folks, i'm wrapping up my setup and want to make my first code change. couple quick things: branch naming, commit message format, PR size expectations, and any CI flakiness i should watch for? also, who do i @ for a quick review? :wave:

kevin: welcome aboard! :tada: our branch pattern is `feature/<TICKET>-short-desc` or `fix/<TICKET>-desc` for bugfixes. ticket = JIRA/DEV number. e.g. feature/DEV-289-health-check.

hema: commit messages use Conventional Commits. short form: `type(scope): short summary (TICKET)` — e.g. `fix(auth): handle refresh token (DEV-289)`. scope is optional but helpful.

kevin: PRs should be focused: prefer <300 LOC and one logical change. if you need schema migrations or infra churn, split into a migration PR + follow-up. for model-serving changes, include a short perf note (latency, memory).

jordan: good call. where is the checklist and PR template?

hema: template is in `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`. checklist includes tests, changelog if user-facing, docs, and a short rollout plan for infra changes. if your change touches an area with a CODEOWNERS entry, they will be auto-requested.

kevin: CI: pre-commit hooks are required — run `pre-commit install && pre-commit run --all-files`. run `make lint` and `pytest tests/unit -q`. frontend TypeScript checks: `pnpm -w build`.

ci-bot: CI queued for commit 9b2f8d  lint: queued, unit: queued, integration: queued.

hema: note on rebasing: we prefer rebasing feature branches on top of main before opening a PR to avoid merge commits. `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main`. force-push only your feature branch, never main.

jordan: any special labels or reviewers i should add?

kevin: add labels: `area/backend` or `area/frontend`, `needs-review`, and `risk/low|medium|high` depending on impact. request 1 reviewer for low-risk, 2 for higher risk. ping @oncall if your change touches infra or rollout scripts.

hema: for DB migrations: small additive migrations allowed in a single PR. destructive changes require a migration plan and feature flag. talk to DB-owners first.

oncall-bot: Reminder: deploy freeze window Fri 18:00- Mon 06:00 UTC. Exceptions require approval from SRE.

jordan: noted re: freeze. last q: branch naming for experiments or WIP?

kevin: use `wip/<short-desc>` for temporary work, but don't leave it long-lived. draft PRs are fine while iterating.

jordan: thanks — i'll open a draft PR for DEV-289 and ping here if CI flakes. appreciate the quick answers :thumbsup:
